ja.reading: へんきょくてんをもとめる

definition_ja: 曲線の凹凸が入れ替わる点を求める。
definition_en: To find the points where a graph changes concavity.

examples.en: To find the points of inflection, set f double prime equal to zero and check that it actually changes sign.
examples.ja: 変曲点を求めるには、f″ = 0 とおいて、そこで本当に符号が変わるかを確かめる。

examples.en: Find the points of inflection of f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x.
examples.ja: f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x の変曲点を求めよ。

sources.title: College Board, AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2020)
